description: Institut Paris Region (L'Institut Paris Region, regional planning agency) publishes the locations of the sports facilities of the Île-de-France region as of 2025, where a facility is a single element such as a swimming pool basin or a long-jump track and the companion installations layer lists the pools and athletics stadiums; the hub says the data are also published on the national open data portal data.gouv.fr and the regional site. Coverage: the Île-de-France region (Paris and its surrounding departments); the layer was last modified on 2026-01-21. Format and access: CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML downloads plus ArcGIS REST feature services, without registration from the Institut Paris Region open data hub. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence ouverte (Etalab Open Licence); cost: free. Caveats: the description points to a separate metadata sheet for the attribute list, which was not read, so the count of facilities and the fields are unconfirmed; capacity and building condition are not part of the description. Simulation uses: public-space and community-facility layers for accessibility, heat-refuge and evacuation-shelter analysis, and for exposure counts of urban facilities in flood and heat studies. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
